tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa'i khyad chos dpal phyag na rdo rje nyi ma mdung gang ma'i skor bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ man ngag 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma rin po che gsal ba'i bzang po de nyid dus re zhig gi tshe/ rong kha phyogs kyi ri khrod cig tu sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nangs ma gcig mi dkar po lag na shel gyi 'khar ba thogs pa zhig mdun gyi bar snang la phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa lan mang du gzigs pas/ der bla mas khyod su yin byas pas/ nga gza' bdud rā hu la yin zer ba dang*/ de nyid la bla mas gtor ma byin nas bden pa brdar te/ khyod kyis sems can la gnod pa btang nas sdug bsngal bas/ de nyid spang dgos te/ phyin chad ma mdzad cig ces bka' bsgo mdzad pas/ kho na re/ sngon gyi las dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis mi byed pa'i dbang ma byung*/ 'on kyang steng nad kyis ma thebs pa rnams la phyis mi 'byung ba dang*/ thebs pa rnams la myur du phan par byed pa'i man ngag cig yod pas 'bul bar zhu zer nas man ngag 'di phul/ bla ma rin po che gsal ba'i bzang po de nyid la/ bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de la don yod dpal bas zhus/ de la chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas zhus/ de nas rim par brgyud pa'o// brgyud pa de rnams las byung ba'i man ngag 'di lta ste/ thog mar nad kyis ma thebs pa rnams la phyis nas kyang mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir nyi shu dgu'i nyi ma mdung gang tsam la/ rang kha nub tu bltas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ de'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sbrul zhags dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub g.yon phyogs su gtad pa/

zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis bgrad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ sku dang yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed/ de la ye shes sems dpa' bstim pa sogs bya/ de ltar gsal ba'i mdun du/ rā hu la sku mdog dud kha/ dbu bcu pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang ba/ sku smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar zhing tshur la gus pa'i tshul gyis 'dud pa/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og mas sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og mas mda' lnga dang bcas pa'i rā'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gdong shin tu smad pa dang bcas pas/ bdag gis bka' ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin du nyan pa tshon gang ba tsam zhig bsam/ sngags 'di zla ba phyi ma'i nyer dgu'i bar la ma chag par bgrang na bskal pa 'bum tsho gsum gyi bar du steng gdon gyi gnod pa mi 'byung zhes gza' dngos kyis gsungs so/ sngags ni/ oṃ nyi ma nan/ zla ba nan/ klad pa nan/ snying mgo nan/ gzhi rtse ltag khung nan/ e tsi tra ma tra zlog e nā ga shig nā ga sod/ nā ga zlog nā ga'i mgo la nan/ zhes bgrangs pa'i sngags kyi 'od zer thim par bsam/ dge'o// ༈ /na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ man ngag 'di'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ rje bla ma rin po che g.ya' bzang pa de nyid/ dus lan cig gi tshe/ rong kha phyogs kyi ri khrod gcig tu sgrub pa dam po mdzad cing bzhugs yod pa'i dus na/ nangs ma gcig gi tshe/ mi dkar po lag na shel gyi 'khar ba khyer ba zhig mdun gyi bar snang la phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa mngon sum du gzigs nas/ de la bla mas khyod su yin byas pas/ nga gza' bdud rā hu la bya ba yin zer ba dang*/

de nyid la bla mas gtor ma byin nas bden pa brdar te/ khyod kyis sems can thams cad la nad sna tshogs btang nas/ duḥkha drag po mi bzod pas gzir du bcug pa 'di 'dra shin tu yang sdig pa che bas/ da phyin chad ma byed cig ces bka' bsgo mdzad pas kho na re/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis 'di lta bu mi byed pa'i dbang med kyis/ 'on kyang sngar nad kyis ma thebs pa rnams la phyis mi 'byung ba dang*/ nad kyis thebs pa rnams myur du phan par byed pa man ngag cig 'bul bar zhu zer nas/ man ngag 'di dngos su phul lo// bla ma rin po che g.ya' bzang pa la/ bla ma khams sgom bya bral nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de la bla ma don yod dpal bas zhus/ de la dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ de nas rim par brgyud do// de ltar brgyud pa de rnams las byung ba'i man ngag gi rim pa ni 'di lta ste/ thog mar nad kyis ma thebs pa rnams la phyis mi 'byung bar byed pa ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i nyi shu dgu'i dgongs mo nyi ma mdung gang tsam yod pa'i dus su/ kha nub tu bltas la/ lus tsog pur bsdad nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed lan gsum byas la/ dkar gtor chab kyis bran nas/ a kā ros bdud rtsir bsam ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rā hu la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun nam lnga la sogs pas gtor ma bsngos nas phrin las bcol/ bdag bskyed ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ de'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sbrul gyi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub g.yon gyi phyogs su gtad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon pa brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis bgrad pa/

stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ sku dang yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me phung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dam tshig pa de la ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstim pa sogs bya'o// de ltar gsal ba'i mdun du/ rā hu la sku mdog dud kha mgo dgu'i 'og ma sum bsgrigs gnyis brtsegs pa'i steng du/ gnyis bsgrigs gcig de'i steng du bya rog gi mgo can/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang ba/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ lag pa bzhi'i dang po gnyis snying gar thal mo sbyar nas/ tshur la gus pa'i tshul gyis 'dud pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na sbrul zhags thogs pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na mda' lnga dang bcas pas rwa'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ gdong shin tu smad pa dang bcas nas/ bdag gis bka' ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin gus pas nyan pa/ mthe bong gi tshigs tsam zhig bsams la/ sngags 'di phyi ma'i nyer dgu'i bar gyi ring la ma chag par bgrang na/ bskal pa 'bum tsho gsum du steng gdon gyi gnod pa mi 'byung zhes gza' dngos kyis gsungs so// sngags ni/ oṃ nyi ma nan/ zla ba nan/ klad pa nan/ snying mgo nan/ gzhi rtse stag khung nan/ e tsi tra ma tra zlog e nā ga shig nā ga sod/ nā ga zlog nā ga'i mgo la nan/ zhes bgrangs pa'i sngags kyi 'od zer de rnams la thim par bsam gsungs so// de ltar bgrangs mi shes pa rnams la srung ba byas nas btags na thub ste/ de yang gro ga'am/ shog bu gtsang ma la 'khor lo rtsibs lnga pa/ rtsibs kyi phyi nang du mu khyud re re dang bcas pa bris pa'i rtsibs lnga'i nang du/ oṃ gtum po li gtum po li/ su su/ me me/ shig shig swā hā/ zhes pa bri/ rtsibs kyi phyi ru/ a ya ma pre du ti sha na la dhe sha na la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bri/

phyi'i mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po bri/ nang gi mu khyud la gong gi sngags ring bri/ lte bar phyag na rdo rje'i rtsa sngags nī lam+ba ra dha ra dang 'chang ba'i ming spel gzhug 'di rnams 'byor na rin po che sna lnga/ ma 'byor na gser rkyang gis bri/ rab gnas dang bkra shis spyi dang mthun par byas la btags par bya'o// ༈ /gnyis pa nad kyis thebs pa rnams legs par bcos pa'i man ngag la/ brtag pa dang bcos thabs dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la bzhi ste/ dang po mig la brtag pa ni/ mig rgyu ma la phus btab pa lta bu yong*/ mig sprin dkar po'i steng du nag thig yong*/ gnyis pa lce la brtag pa ni/ lce'i ra ma lug rgyas te/ me tog rdol yong*/ gsum pa sen mo la brtag pa ni/ sen mo la dmar po'i mdangs mi yong*/ bzhi pa rtsa la brtag pa ni/ rtsa la sdod 'theng yong*/ sems mi dga' ba dang*/ glo snying khar 'tshangs pa dang*/ grogs la tshig pa za ba dang*/ lus gyi mdun rgyab bshal nas na ba dang*/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad sbrid pa dang*/ mgo 'khor ba dang*/ mig mi gsal ba dang*/ mchu skam pa dang*/ lus la tshad pa rgyas pa dang*/ grang shums la sogs pa byung na/ gza'i nad nges par yod/ de ltar ngos zin nas/ gnyis pa bcos thabs dngos la/ nad nang du zhi bar bya ba dang*/ phyi ru spo ba dang gnyis las/ dang po nad pa de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byin rlabs can bzhugs pa'i lha khang ngam/ mchod rten gyi drung ngam/ mi grib can mi 'grims pa'i gnas dben par khrid nas bzhag de'i steng du dge slong gtsang ma'i chos gos kyi bla re phub/ mgo la rma bya'i sgro mdongs 'dzugs/ ske la dkar phra man btags/ gzhan yang rgyal 'gong la sogs pa'i sgrib shing gi srung ba 'grub tshad btags/ mal sa yang zhag re bzhin spo bar bya'o// zas spyod ni/ rgan khog la drod/ dar ma la bsil/ byis pa la bsil drod snyoms par bya/ khyad par rgan gzhon thams cad la/

sbrang bzang po chu thag bcad nas byin na dga'o// sha dmar po dang*/ zho dron mo dang*/ g.yer ma'i chab mig la sogs spang bar bya/ rnga sgra dang gshang sgra dung sgra dang ngu 'bod la sogs pa'i sgra chen po rnams mi thos par bya'o// khrab gon pa dang*/ 'thabs rtsod la sogs pa'i sar mi 'gro/ khur chen po khur ba dang*/ mchongs rgyug la sogs pa'i drag po'i las mi 'chol/ chu la brgal ba dang*/ ko ba la grol ba dang*/ rta bong la sogs pa la rjen zhon byed du mi 'jug mig lam du sha dmar lpags dmar rdza dmar la sogs dang*/ chu lang ling dang*/ me long la sogs pa'i 'od chags can gyi dngos po mi bzhag nad 'go ma 'chos pa nas/ nad las grol gyi bar du/ snyan pa'i gtam gyis nad pa'i sems gso ba la sogs kyi mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*/ mi snyan pa'i rigs kyi gtam gang yang rna bar mi brjod pa sogs kyi 'gal rkyen rnams spang bar bya'o// kha yo ba dang*/ mig yo ba la sogs la sngags kyi chu blud de/ dkar gong gi sgyid bu gsum btsugs pa'i khar sla nga bzhag pa'i nang du/ kha mig ma yo ba ngos nas yang yang bcos par bya'o// yang kha lkugs nas smra mi shes na/ slar dkar gong gi sgyid pu btsugs pa'i khar bzhag pa'i nang du/ lug mgo gcig gi kha skam pas brgyangs nas bzhag ste/ skam pa gcig gis nad pa'i lo grangs shig lug mgo'i kha nang gi skam pa la brdeg de'i bar la/ oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la swā hā/ zhes nad pa la yid kyis bzla ru 'jug go /yan lag zha 'khums byung na/ sngags chus bkrus te/ yang nas yang du 'then nyed dang*/ brkyang bskum sogs mang du bya'o// yang don snying sogs la zin nas gzer thabs su na na/ mgar ba'i so thog la sngags btab nas/ gang na sar dugs yang yang bya zhing*/ khong du sngags chu btang ngo*// gzhan yang nangs ma re bzhin/ sngags chus mgo mjug yan lag rnams ril por bkru zhing*/ bza' btung rnams la yang sngags mang du brdeg go

/gnyis pa phyi ru spo ba'i cho ga la/ rdzas gsag pa dang*/ sbur chog dngos gnyis las/ dang por dug dang*/ spyang ki'i brun/ khyi dkar po sna dmar gyi brun/ rta nag 'og yod kyi rta bon/ la cha/ shu dag nag po/ bong nga nag po/ sgog skya gcig skyes/ yug sa mo'i mngal khrag gu gul nag po/ 'di rnams kyi dud pas zhag gsum gyi gong nas bdug par bya'o// gnyis pa sbur ba dngos ni/ 'o ma dang chu bsres pa gzhong pa'am ka tor la sogs pa'i snod gang rung du blugs la/ de'i nang du nya chung zhig bzung nas bcug de nad pa'i lag pa g.yon pa la gtad la/ gtum po li la sogs pa'i sngags bgrang du 'jug bla ma nyid kyis/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ gong gi phyag na rdo rje gsal bar bsgoms la/ sngags ring brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang drag sngags kyi rigs shes tshad bgrang la/ nad pa'i rna ba g.yas pa nas brdeg go /nad pa rang gis bsgom rgyu'i dmigs pa ni/ bla ma phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ phyag na rdo rje de lta bu 'od zer phra mo dpag tu med pa 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa char babs pa ltar byung nas/ nad pa'i spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad gang nas nang du zhugs/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad mer gyis gang bas/ 'od zer dang gzi brjid kyis nad gdon thams cad rna ba g.yon pa nas mar thon nas/ chu nang gi nya chung la thim pa'i dmigs pa byed du 'jug go /de ltar byas pas rtags ci rigs pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar rtags gang rigs byung nas/ nyi nub tu btang*/ phug ron yin na byang du btang*/ ra yin na shar du bskyal/ yug sa mo'i dor rtas nad pa'i mgo gtum la/ rdzas kyi dud pas rkang mthil nas mgo'i bar thams cad gdug par bya'o// de nas nad thon pa dang*/ phyis mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gong gi srung ba gnyis dang ma bral bar byas te bcang ngo*// yang gong gi sngags ring bgrangs tshar ba dang*/

mdun gyi rā hu la de nyid kyis phyag gi mda' gzhu rang la phul te/ gus pas 'dud pa dang*/ kho'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i phyir du kaṃ ka ni'am ma ṇi brgya rtsa gcig bgrangs pas kho'i sdig sgrib dag ste/ mgo gong ma brgyad po rtsa ba'i mgo la thim/ lag pa tha ma gnyis rtsa ba'i lag pa la thim/ sbrul mjug rkang pa gnyis su gyur/ mig rnams kyang gcig la gcig thim nas rtsa ba'i mig gnyis la thim nas/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ lha'i bu'i cha lugs su gyur par bsam/ de la gtor ma gcig byin te/ mthar rā hu la gats+tsha zhes pas rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad do// zhes pa 'di pha nag po ro zan gyi man ngag go/ ༈ /lag len zhib tu bkod pa ni/ mdun du gtor ma zlum po dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa zhig bsham/ rang nyid phyag rdor gyi mngon rtogs gzhung bzhin bsgoms pa'i mdun du/ gza' mchog sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed cing*/ spos dud btang zhing spyan drangs la/ rtsa sngags brjod/ de nas gtor ma phul nas phrin las bcol/ gza' mchog 'khor bcas kyi/ zhal phyag thams cad rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ mjug ma rkang pa gnyis su gyur te/ lha bu'i cha lugs su gyur nas/ kho'i sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i phyir du/ kaṃ ka ni dang ma ṇi gang mang brjod pas/ thugs dges te lho phyogs su byon par bsams la gshegs gsol bya'o// bla ma rin po che gsal ba'i bzang po yang zer/ bla ma g.ya' bzang ba'i lugs kyi man ngag nyi ma mdung gang ma zhes bya ba rgyas bsdus gnyis rdzogs so// dge'o// ༈ /grub chen g.ya' bzang pa'i lugs kyi dpal phyag na rdo rje'i mngon rtogs nyi ma mdung gang ma bzhugs so// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra pā ṇa ye nā mya/ 'dir phyag na rdo rje nyi ma mdung gang ma'i man ngag rje'i gsung la zin bris su byas pa 'di la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las ri yi rgyal po ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/ pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa khro bo'i sdigs mdzub sbrul zhags dang bcas pa g.yon phyogs su bsdigs pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs par hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par bstim zhing*/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur pa la/ mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ thugs kar nyi gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag de'i mtha' skor du/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ nī lam+ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rādz+nya pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas shing mchod bstod 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ rang gi mdun du gza' rā hu la sku mdog dud kha mgo dgu pa phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar bas rang nyid la gus pa'i tshul gyis 'dud pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na rwa'i mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na rwa'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ gdong shin tu smad pa dang bcas pas bdag gis ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka' gus pas nyan par bsams la/ oṃ nyi ma nan/ zla ba nan/ klad pa nan/ snying mgo nan/ gzhi rtse ltag khung nan/ e tsi tra ma tra zlog nā ga shig nā ga zlog nā ga sod/ nā ga'i mgo la nan swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa re bzlas so// mthar gza' rā hu la je chung je chung du song bar bsams la stong nyid kyi ngang la bzhag go

/'di'i dus tshod dgong mo nyi ma mdung gang tsam la shis so// de nas do nub nyi ma ma mthong bar byed pa gnad yin no// bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab par bya'o// zhes pa'ang kun mkhyen chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung rgyun bzhin tha shod dben pa'i ri khrod du/ chos med kyi bya btang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gis ye ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /chos rje g.ya' bzang pa'i lugs kyi phyag rdor nyi ma mdung gang ma'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra pā ṇa ye na mya/ de la 'dir phyag na rdo rje nyi ma mdung gang ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sbyor ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad rdo rwa me ris bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐ ngam rdo rje/ yang na me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i steng du mañji'i khar snod gas chag bug rdol med pa'i nang du gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum pa theb kyu bcad kha nang bstan phyogs mtshams brgyad dang*/ de'i steng du'ang mtshams mtshams su theb kyu brgyad kyis bskor ba la dkar rgyan gyis mdzes par spras pa de nyid la mda' dar sngon po dang phyag rdor gyi tsaka li dang bcas pa btsugs par mchod gtor bzang pos bskor ba'o/ de nas slob dpon gyi mdun du lcogs rtse'i khar nang mchod rdor dril ḍā ma ru chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang bcas pa bshams nas/ nang mchod byin rlabs sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas khang dang mchod pa byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod bstod 'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa'i bar byas nas/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri zlum pos bskor ba'i nang du rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus na ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/

sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la rten gtor hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhes pa nas/ mchod cing bstod pa'i bar dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rten gtor phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar/ zhes pa nas/ rādz+nya pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes brgya dang brgyad bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ mthar mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ bla ma bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rjes bdag dang sems can thams cad la drang srong gza' yi gnod pa las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba btab nas mdun bskyed la gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar phul zhing*/ spro na slob dpon rang nyid kyis kyang slob ma la rjes gnang gi cho ga ji ltar 'bogs pa ltar blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol du khrus byas shing 'jug yon phyag dang ldan pas gral la 'khod de maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// rgyun bshags/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces 'di dag lan gsum gsum brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dwangs ma yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal ba'i spyi bor pad nyi'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/

zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal ba'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams khra spung nger bzhugs par mos te gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje gnyis su med pas bdag la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba bka' bcol dang bcas pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi rten gtor khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma phyag na rdo rje rnams la mos gus dung pa mdzad pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang la sogs pa ste/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gsang ba'i bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'khor bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rdo rje'i spun dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba che ba ri rab tsam chung ba til phran tsam dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i spyi bo'i bla ma phyag na rdo rje'i sku la rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la char bab pa lta bur sib sib thim pas/ de'i rkyen gyis de nyid 'od du ltem zhu/ khyed rang rnams phyag na rdo rje dam tshig par gsal ba la ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa de nyid thim par gyur pas/ dam tshig dang ye shes pa gnyis su med pa'i sku snang stong bde ba chen po la rig pa skad cig kyang ma yengs par mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes dang rol mo bya zhing gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ rtsa sngags tshar ci mang bzla ba dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng chad zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams phyag rdor du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas su 'khor ba las/

'od zer sngags rgod me stag spu gri'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas drang srong gza'i gnod pa thams cad bya sgro mes tshigs pa bzhin du thul thul bsregs shing gzhom par dmigs nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces rtsa sngags la sngags gnyis tshar gsum nas nyer gcig gi bar brjod nas/ slar yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar 'go bar mdzod// ces brjod nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgo bor me tog 'jog pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ de dag ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas/ slob dpon la mos gus dung mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi rten gtor la phog de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams phyag rdor du gsal ba'i snying ga nas zhugs/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha gyen bstan du phyogs pa'i nang du gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gyen du 'grengs pa'i lte bar rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog sna tshogs pas g.yas su bskor ba las snying kha zum gyis zum pa la/ rtsa ba'i sngags phreng gis bskor zhing bcings par mos nas gnas lugs 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po lhun grub 'dus ma byas kyi ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas gtor ma mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar dang bcas te slob ma'i spyi bor 'jog pa dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam tshig chen po la bzhag cing*/ thugs dam phrin las bskul ba ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis kyang thugs dam bskul ba yin pas/ rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid la bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'go zhing 'grogs pa'i dam tshig thugs dam chen po las skad cig kyang g.yel ba med pas rjes su bzung ba dang 'jigs byed drang srong chen po gza' bdud rā hu la'i gnod pa las bsrung ba dang*/

skyob pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ mthun rkyen ma lus thams cad tshul bzhin du sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ ye dharmā ci mang brjod/ de nas sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar nyi ma mdung gang ma'i man ngag sbyin par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar gdams pa phog pa'i nyams len tshul bzhin du nyams su len snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes brjod nas/ bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs nas/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod nas/ dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos shing bsang sbyangs byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ phyi nang gis mchod cing bstod nas/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gi cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa dang ser sna'i dbang gis mchod gtor ngan zhing chung ba dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis rgyud sde nas byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang 'khrugs shing nongs pa thams cad bzod par bzhes nas/ bdag la sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs dang*/ lhag pa dang ni zhes sogs dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// zhes sogs kyis mdun bskyed kyi dam ye gnyis ka rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ zhes brjod nas/ rang dang grogs kyi gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge rtsa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos shing shis pa brjod pa dang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// zhes pa 'di nyid dad ldan gyi slob ma mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ bla ma paṇa chen gyi gsung bzhin chos med kyi bya btang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gis khro mo'i lo sa ga zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi bzang po'i tshes la me long bkra shis rab brtan bde chen chos 'khor gling du legs par sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig

'di'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ drang srong rā hu la/ g.ya' bzang chos rje/ khams sgom nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bla ma don yod dpal/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ theg chen kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma chos grags pa/ rje rin chen bkra shis/ bshes gnyen rin chen bzang po/ gangs can kun dga' dpal/ gling smad paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab dpal ldan/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ kun mkhyen byams pa chos nyid/ des bdag pad+ma gar dbang la'o// ༈ /rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa'i khyad chos nyi ma mdung gang ma'i bsnyen yig zhal gdams smar khrid du bkod pa bzhugs so// chos kyi rje g.ya' bzang pa'i gdams pa khyad par can nyi ma mdung gang ma nyams su blang thabs gzhung na gab sbas kyi tshul du gnang ba snyan brgyud yig chung logs su gab pa phyogs gcig tu sdeb mi shes pa rnams kyi don du rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen dar rgyas kyi gsung rgyun zab khyad bklag chog mar bri bar bya ste/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i nyer dgu nas phyi ma'i nyer dgu'i bar dgong re bzhin nyi ma mdung gang tsam yod pa'i dus nges par sgrub pa po bla gab med pa'i sar kha nub phyogs su gtad la 'dug pa'i mdun du gtor chung zur gsum theb kyu re dang bcas pa stegs la bsham/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed la/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho ྅haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sa gzhi thams cad rgya mtsho sngo la dwangs pa'i dbus su ri rab bang rim bzhi pa de'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sbrul gyi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub g.yon phyogs su gdengs pa/

zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i tshul du bgrad pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra dang sma ra gyen du brdzes pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ sku'i yan lag dang nying lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rang la gnyis med du gyur/ yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi gong ltar mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing gi mtha' skor du sngags phreng bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng ba lta bu rang sgra dang bcas 'khod par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ nī lam+ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nya pa ya ti swā hā/

brgya rtsa gcig bzlas/ de nas rang nyid phyag rdor du gsal ba'i mdun du rā hu la dud kha mgo dgu pa'i 'og ma sum bsgrigs nyis brtsegs/ de'i steng du nyis bsgrigs gcig de'i steng du bya rog gi mgo bo can/ lus thams cad mig gis gang ba/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ lag pa bzhi'i dang po gnyis snying gar thal mo sbyar ba g.yas 'og ma sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs pa/ g.yon 'og ma mda' lnga dang bcas pa'i rwa'i gzhu thogs pa/ gdong shin tu smad pa dang bcas pa'i bongs tshad mtheb tshigs tsam pa/ de yang bdag gi bka' ji ltar bsgo ba thams cad nyan par bsam/ bzla sngags ni/ oṃ nyi ma nan/

phrag g.yas/ zla ba nan/ phrag g.yon/ klad pa nan/ mgo bo thams cad kyi spyi gtsug snying mgo nan/ nu phrag tu/ /gzhi rtse ltag khung nan/ ltag khung du/ e tsi tra ma tra zlog mgrin par/ e nā ga shig mgo bo 'og ma gsum gyi dpral bar/ nā ga song*/ bar pa gsum gyi dpral bar/ nā ga zlog steng ma gnyis kyi dpral bar/ nā ga'i mgo la nan/ bya rog gi dpral bar/ sngags re dang 'od zer gnas su spro skabs rang nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros te rā hu la'i gnas rnams su thim par bsam/ thun re la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad re yin la/ de yang sngags lnga bcu tsam song ba dang rā hu la sku mdog dkar por song bar bsam/ bdun cu song ba dang sbrul mjug kyang khog par thim par bsam/ dgu bcu go lnga song ba dang mgo bo steng ma rnams dang zhal g.yas g.yon rnams rtsa zhal la thim/ sbrul mjug kyang lhag ma ma lus par khog par thim nas rkang pa gnyis skyes par bsam/ de nas brgya rtsa brgyad song ba dang lag 'og ma gnyis kyi phyag mtshan rnams rang phyag rdor du gsal ba la phul nas bka' nyan gsung sdod las thams cad sgrub par bsam/ lag pa 'og ma gnyis gong mar thim/ lus kyi mig rnams rin po che'i rgyan du gyur par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma la bsang chus bran la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma 'dod yon gyi phung po phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ke ta ke ta rā hu la pū dza i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ ā tsa mā na pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ puṣ+pe/

dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// mtshan gsol gza' mchog rwa hu la// dam tshig can la bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba// dge legs phun sum tshogs pa yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes se gol gtogs pas rā hu la kha bsgyur te phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du song bar bsam/ rang gsang ba'i bdag po yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ de yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la gzhag mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gsang ba'i bdag po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// khyed kyi sa la 'khod par shog /ces smon lam btab ste thun las ldang bar bya'o// de ltar gza' bcos nyi ma mdung gang ma 'di la g.ya' bzang pa'i gzim chung ma'i skor/ sham po bcal gyi skor/ rong gi skor sogs dang*/ khams sgom chen pos rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa'i zhal gdams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sogs yig sna mang bas gcig tu bsdu ba'i gsal byed sdeb ma shes par sna re tsam la chog shes kyi rgyun 'byams pas 'dra min mang por 'chol bas the tshom gyi drwa bar gyur pa/ slar dpal ri theg chen gling na rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen dar rgyas zhes mkhyen pa nus mthu'i mnga' bdag de la/

khams sgom chen po'i zin bris dang snyan brgyud zhal rgyun yi ger ma 'khod pa sogs g.ya' bzang pa bshes gnyen phun tshogs zhes lugs 'di la grub pa thob pas rang gzhan gyi don 'grub nges pa de'i zhal rgyun rnam par dag pa de'i thog nas thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i zhal khrid thugs myong gis brgyan pa bka' drin chen pos stsal pa brjed par phangs nas sngags btsun phrin las lhun grub kyis phyogs gcig tu bris pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
